summary_en: 2,000,000 shares (0.89% of S/O), ¥5.0B upper limit, ¥2,500/share implied ceiling, open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange, Aug 6–Sep 30, 2026. Rationale: stable shareholder return aligned with mid-term plan NOF VISION 2030 Stage III target of ≥70% payout ratio.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
NOF Corporation announced a treasury stock acquisition program authorizing the purchase of up to 2,000,000 shares (0.89% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) for a maximum of ¥5.0 billion. The program will run from August 6 to September 30, 2026, via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The implied ceiling price is ¥2,500 per share.

The company frames the acquisition as part of its commitment to stable shareholder return, specifically aligned with its mid-term plan NOF VISION 2030 Stage III (FY2026–2028), which targets a payout ratio of 70% or higher. Management cited capital efficiency as the primary driver for implementing the buyback. As of July 31, 2026, the company held 11,675,843 treasury shares (excluding 97,300 shares held by its employee trust), out of 224,848,285 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
